Posture Check Reminder

Set a posture-check interval to get rotating desk-posture tips as an on-page banner, with optional browser notifications.

Reminders are off.

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Reminders run while this tab is open.

📖 How to use

  1. Set your reminder interval in minutes.
  2. Press Start reminders.
  3. Read each rotating posture tip in the banner.
  4. Optionally enable browser notifications.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How often should reminders fire?

Every 30–60 minutes is a good rhythm — often enough to matter, not so often you ignore it.

How do browser notifications work?

Press Enable notifications and accept the browser prompt. They work while this tab is open.

Do reminders keep running if I close the tab?

No — reminders live in this tab only. Close the tab to stop them.

What tips will I see?

Shoulders back, chin tucked, feet flat, screen at eye level — the banner rotates through a full checklist.
